bias.en: Uptrend pausing · pinned under the 5 and 10-day averages
bias.zh: 上升趋势暂停 · 受制于 5 日和 10 日均线

read.en: Microsoft rose 0.2% on Oct 21 to $532.95 on light volume, trading between $525.02 and $533.28. It sits just under the falling 5-day ($533.4) and rising 10-day ($534.3) averages, above the rising 30-day ($515.8), 100-day ($458.5) and 200-day ($436.1). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 19 and is above zero, with the histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 16 ($549.58), and RSI is 59.
read.zh: 微软 10月21日上涨 0.2%，收于 $532.95，成交清淡，盘中区间 $525.02–533.28。股价略低于下行的 5 日（$533.4）和上行的 10 日均线（$534.3），位于上行的 30 日（$515.8）、100 日（$458.5）和 200 日均线（$436.1）上方。MACD 自 10月19日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月16日起看空（$549.58），RSI 为 59。

read.en: No level changed: the $524.4 Oct 16 low held a third time (day's low $525.0) and the high stopped at the short averages. Resistance is $533.4–534.3 (5 and 10-day averages), then $544 (Oct 16 high) and $549.6–553.7 (SAR, Oct 13 high, October 2025 record). Support is $524.4–525.0 (Oct 16 and 21 lows), then $515.8 (30-day) and $486. A close below $515.8 would open $486.
